en.headline: Election Committee subsector polls set for 22 November
en.dek: The Chief Executive has gazetted Sunday 22 November as the polling day for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections, with nominations running from 7 to 20 October.
body: A Government spokesman said on Friday that the Chief Executive has, under the Chief Executive Election Ordinance, specified Sunday 22 November 2026 as the polling date for the Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections to return elected members of the new-term Election Committee. The notice was published in the Gazette the same day.

The nomination period will open on 7 October and close on 20 October. The Chief Electoral Officer will later publish a notice setting out the period and places for submitting nomination forms, together with other operational details.

The Government said it will continue to work closely with the Electoral Affairs Commission on preparatory arrangements so that the elections can be conducted openly, honestly, fairly, safely and in an orderly, efficient and user-friendly manner.

zh.headline: 選委會界別分組選舉投票日定11月22日
zh.dek: 行政長官已刊憲指明2026年11月22日為選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉投票日，提名期由10月7日至20日。
body: 政府發言人周五表示，行政長官已根據《行政長官選舉條例》附表第16條，指明2026年11月22日（星期日）為2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉的投票日期，以選出新一屆選委會的選任委員，相關公告已於同日憲報刊登。
選舉提名期將於10月7日開始，至10月20日結束。總選舉事務主任稍後會刊登公告，指明呈交提名表格的限期和地點，並公布相關細節。
政府會繼續與選舉管理委員會緊密合作，積極進行籌備工作，務求令選舉在公開、誠實、公平、安全有序、高效和人性化的情況下順利舉行。
